{
  "thinking": "Maya wants a butterfly, and it suits the launch and the no-bird brief better than the fish. Reviews on the fish don't carry over, and Priya hasn't reviewed yet, so I can't lock. I'll redraw on the pad and ask for fresh reviews.",
  "say": "Good call, Maya. A butterfly fits the launch and the no-bird brief better. I've redrawn it on the pad: big wings as the outline, body down the middle, antennae at the top. The run starts at the tip of the left antenna and flows down into the body, and the wings branch off the body. Tom, Priya, could you look at the wing joins? Once you've both reviewed the new version, I'll lock it.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "point": [15, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "label", "x": 13, "y": 0.5, "text": "START"},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[13, 1], [14, 2.5], [15, 4], [15, 8], [15, 12], [15, 16]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[15, 7], [11, 4], [6, 3], [3, 6], [3, 9], [6, 12], [11, 13], [15, 13]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[15, 7], [19, 4], [24, 3], [27, 6], [27, 9], [24, 12], [19, 13], [15, 13]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[15, 4], [16, 2.5], [17, 1]]}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Switched from fish to butterfly. Draft on pad: stroke 1 = left antenna tip (START) down the body spine to the bottom; stroke 2 = left wing branching off spine at upper body, looping back to the spine; stroke 3 = mirror right wing; stroke 4 = right antenna branching up from spine top. Fish reviews don't count. Need fresh reviews from Tom, Priya and Maya on the butterfly before locking. Then build: trace 1, 2, 3, 4 (wings after spine). Check wing joins and antenna tip with squint once drawn."
}
